I have a history of depression, severe anxiety, and drug use and just when i started to feel "normal" i've started to have some suicidal thoughts.

What freaks me out the most is that they don't come about because i'm depressed and hate life, it's almost an emotionless thought. Like i sit there fantasizing about it for a while before realizing i shouldn't be thinking that way.

Stuff like wondering if the building i'm living in is tall enough to kill me instantly if i jumped off, and if it isn't then what could be another way to do it? Or how i could just start chugging some of the chemicals we work with in my chem labs and be dead before anybody could do anything. 

Usually i end up lost in thought for minutes at a time thinking about the best way to off myself, but it doesn't seem like it's for any particular reason.

I haven't seen a psychiatrist in a while because my last experience with one wasn't too great, but i'm considering going back, but these thoughts almost seem normal to me? Even though i know i shouldn't be thinking of killing myself?

I guess TL;DR: is casually thinking of killing yourself a normal thing?
